input:
Earlier scenes:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

This scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 如果：delete it，An embedded yes/no question after “不知道” cannot use “如果”; it needs an A-not-A form instead. [rule: a_not_a_question]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 好：好不好，The embedded question needs the A-not-A form to ask whether the flower benefits the body. [rule: a_not_a_question]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看如果：看，After “看,” the clause already uses the A-not-A form “毒不毒,” so “如果” is not used. [rule: a_not_a_question]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：他吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，This asks which of two plants he ate, so use “是……还是……” rather than “吃不吃……或者……”. [rule: a_not_a_question]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 你的身体：他的身体，There is no listener addressed as “你”; the flower is being tested by 神农, so this pronoun should refer back to him. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他一吃花：他一吃那种花，The earlier sentence introduces a particular different kind of flower; “那种花” refers back to that plant instead of making “花” sound like flowers in general. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 如果 cannot introduce the embedded yes/no question after 不知道 here.
The intended embedded question requires 好不好 rather than just 好.
如果 is incorrect before the existing 毒不毒 alternative question.
The error is that 神农 does not know whether he should eat it, but the correction wrongly changes this into asking which plant he ate.
你 has no established addressee, while 他 can refer back to 神农.
花 can naturally refer back to the flower just mentioned, so adding 那种 is optional rather than required.
